Venue: Gate
Headline: Trenches Hot Tokens Competition Phase 72: Trade FIONA, Rings and Other Hot Tokens to Share a 20,000...

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Trenches Hot Tokens Competition Phase 72 is officially live. Trade designated hot tokens and share a 20,000 USDT airdrop.
You must click "Join Now" to participate and trade the designated hot tokens to be eligible for rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 20, 2026, 04:00 – November 23, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## Hot Token List
Only the combined buy and sell volume of the following designated hot tokens will be counted. Please verify the token name, chain, and contract address before trading.
FIONA (SOL): B34nXKzCgsJb9ChLuSHPRpXLE3WFSWyeT8Cqkzzmpump
DCTY (ETH): 0x5659250b7aac8f66701c7655da16070ecad6355e
TAPEX (BSC): 0xec3cd8b19c2bddadbbc22e58dbcffa2fb6957777
Rings (SOL): 65iH8k736QNhuUHm1tt8X7yJXpJ517HPPq8BrVdwring
## New User Definition
New users are those who have never traded in the Trenches zone (including the former Gate Alpha zone) before the event starts. Users with any trading record in these zones before the event starts are not eligible for new user rewards.
## Reward 1: First Come, First Served, Share 10,000 USDT
During the event, the first 3,300 users whose cumulative trading volume (buy and sell) of designated hot tokens reaches 500 USDT will each receive token rewards worth 3 USDT, ranked by the time they reach the threshold. Prize pool: 10,000 USDT, limited and first come, first served.
## Reward 2: 10,000 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher Pool for New Users
New Trenches users whose cumulative trading volume of designated hot tokens reaches 100 USDT during the event will receive a 10 USDT Fee Rebate Voucher. Prize pool: 10,000 USDT, while supplies last.
## How to Participate
Go to the Trenches zone, search for the designated hot token contracts, and start trading.
## Notes
All participants must complete identity verification to claim rewards.
Only users who sign up and trade the designated hot tokens during the event are eligible for rewards.
Rewards from the same type of activity cannot be stacked.
Trading volume is calculated as the combined buy and sell volume of the designated hot tokens listed above.
Hot tokens change with each phase, and future phases will not use tokens from previous phases as reward trading tokens.
Before trading hot tokens, please carefully verify the token address and chain. Token information is contributed by community members. If any correction is needed, please contact customer support promptly.
Event page data is for reference only and will be updated within 1–2 hours.
Reward values shown on the event page are estimates for reference only. All airdrop rewards will be distributed as Trenches token mystery boxes, and the actual amount received is subject to token price fluctuations.
Rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
When entering Trenches for the first time, users must follow the guide to complete the Innovation Trading Disclaimer quiz and sign the relevant user agreement. Trenches token projects may involve high risk and volatility. Please invest cautiously after fully understanding the risks.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person's identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
In the event of any discrepancy between translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate reserves the sole discretion and final right of interpretation for this event, and may modify the relevant terms or cancel the event without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions may not be able to access all or part of the services (including participation in this event, games, or competitions). For details on restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.
